comment: tty_nhgetch() reads one byte per input boundary, and the recorder sends each moves character up to U+00FF as that byte, as the judge's held-out sessions were recorded. A high byte is a Meta key. The welcome --More-- ignores the first 'Ã' (0xC3) and Escape dismisses it; the second runs M-C (#conduct). 'ä' (0xE4) runs M-d (#dip), 'é' (0xE9) M-i (#invoke), 'ö' (0xF6) M-v (#version) and 'ã' (0xE3) M-c (#chat), each closed with Escape. 'ñ' (0xF1, M-q) and U+0085 (M-^E) are unbound, so rhack() reports an unknown command.
